The change applies through the one shared retrieval path for both game mode and lookup mode
The assembled prompt text is unchanged by this slice outside the internal query
Multi-card recall@5 lands within 0.10 of the same build's clean-query recall@5 on the Slice A benchmark
Clean-query recall@5 does not regress below the Slice A baseline
Labelled fixtures and the relevance report are re-run; relabeling is a hand judgment, never copied from current scorer output
functional-requirements.md carries the new REQ-178 entry and corrected REQ-074/REQ-167 lines
quick-lookup/README.md, system-map/prompt-layout-spec.md, system-map/game-rules-retrieval.md, and user-flows.md carry this step's query-construction wording
